name: MCP Add Tool
description: Curates ONE tool from an MCP server at a catalog path you choose (#80). The bridged op is self-contained (server, tool name, auth reference, schema all in the asset) — no registry entry, and groups are just catalog paths: place tools from different servers under a common prefix (e.g. o/research/) to arrange them as a set. Paths under your own o/ need nothing extra; v/ops/... requires the mcp/manage ability. Remove with covia:delete on the path — nothing resurrects it. To mirror ALL of a server's tools instead, use v/ops/mcp/add-server. Browse a server's tools first with v/ops/mcp/tools-list.

server.description: Base URL of the MCP server the tool lives on (http/https)

tool.description: The remote tool's name exactly as the server lists it

path.description: Catalog destination for the bridged op, naming the op itself — e.g. o/research/search_papers (your operations) or v/ops/... (venue catalog, needs mcp/manage)

auth.description: Optional bearer credential: a secret reference 's/<name>' (recommended, stored via v/ops/secret/set), a DID-qualified reference 'did:.../s/<name>', or a literal token (discouraged — persists on the lattice)

name.description: Optional display-name override for the bridged op

description.description: Optional description override — survives refresh (curated refresh never touches name/description)

default.description: Optional argument defaults, any value types — merged under the caller's input at dispatch (caller wins). Defaulted keys leave the schema's required list. Purpose-shaping, not policy: use a capability gate to enforce values. Don't put credentials here — they persist plainly; use auth or the secret store
